name: Lake Waveland Park
evidence: Operator modern-camping map + leaf-off IN ortho 39.8878,-87.0745: loops ~440 m N of pin. North row ~35-40 m from east arm through continuous wooded slope; 3DEP ~10 m cliff (operator: 'steep cliff'). Field pads have road + woods before water. Not below dam. Primitive sites unlocated, not counted.

name: Riverview Campground (Madison)
evidence: City page: 18 sites 'bordering' Ohio River, Riverfront rate. Esri 38.7322,-85.365: south row rears ~53-57 m across open, unused mown apron to high-water edge, no levee/road/day use, scattered trees with gaps. 3DEP ~2 m step then flat, walkable. South row only (18 of 33); at the ~50 m bound.

name: Unhitched Rising Sun RV Park
evidence: IN ortho 38.9727,-84.8440: inner-loop RV pads ring central pond, east-side RVs ~5-20 m from water. River section 38.9756,-84.8338 not earned: east row rears ~34-38 m with last ~25 m continuous wooded bank; 'Riverfront' types are operator tags, no site map ties them.

name: Rockville Lake Park
evidence: Operator: 12 'Lakefront' modern sites 1-12, 25 ft max, by rec area. IN ortho 39.7786,-87.2202: south row ~60-95 m to water across paved lot, shelters, playground, beach lawn = developed day use, so not on-water; open sightline across it earns view. North row screened by treed bank; other loops wooded.

name: Sunset Park (Linton)
evidence: Leaf-off IN ortho 39.0538,-87.1412 (0.11 m/px): pads on neck between two strip-pit lakes; east-side gravel ~11-22 m from east lake through thin one-crown fringe, no road between. But $20 nightly / $300 monthly and dark-roofed units leave open whether those east pads sell by the night, so lakefront not earned; lakeview stands.

name: Peaceful Waters Campground
evidence: Campspot map: only RV sites near pond are 35-38 (other pond squares are Primitive Tent; all other RV sites beyond the loop road or along US-41). Schematic map draws 35-38 at the water, but IN ortho 39.818,-87.234 + operator photo RV 38 show the loop road between pads and pond, ~17-25 m (view at best; no pond-view value).

name: Yellowwood State Forest Campground
evidence: Leaf-off IN ortho 39.1790,-86.3384: Red Pine west tip ~32-35 m from lake through continuous wooded point, loop road on the water side at tip; no open apron. Other loops ~62 m+ back.

name: Buzzard Roost Recreation Area (Hoosier National Forest)
evidence: Leaf-off IN ortho + rec.gov site coords (site 4 38.119897,-86.465522): nearest pad ~170 m straight-line to Ohio River down forested bluff (~199 m vs river ~117 m). rec.gov site attributes carry no Proximity to Water tag; overlook is off the pads.
